study_identification_part.si4_title: Cortical thickness and grey-matter volume anomaly detection in individual MRI scans: Comparison of two methods

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Compare ScanOMetrics anomaly detection using features from FreeSurfer vs DL+DiReCT on OASIS3, assess clinical relevance, speed, and agreement with known AD patterns.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: ROC curves for entorhinal CTh and hippocampal volume; group effect sizes (Cohen's d); normalized L2-distance to AD template vs CDR.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: AD scans show up to ~20× higher anomaly rates than HCs, with CTh reductions in AD predilection regions; DL+DiReCT is ~15× faster than FreeSurfer with similar patterns.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Using cleaned HC norms, 56.0% (DL+DiReCT) and 61.7% (FreeSurfer) of AD scans (CDR≥1) were anomalous vs ~1% of HCs. Regional CTh reductions concentrated in bilateral entorhinal, fusiform, precuneus, supramarginal; progression with higher CDR. Processing time: FreeSurfer 9h20m±2h50m vs DL+DiReCT ~24m±4m30s. ROC for entorhinal CTh and hippocampal volume show moderate discrimination.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Open-source pipeline (ScanOMetrics) with reproducible models and code; suggests combining normative residuals with classifiers/progression models; plans for GUI/QReports.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Validation confined to OASIS3; no external-domain validation. Many metric residuals deviate from normality even after cleaning. Site/scanner handled by matching rather than explicit model terms; potential sensitivity to acquisition differences.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Compared ScanOMetrics with PCN toolkit and BrainChart for reference (e.g., z-score correlation; centile correspondence in supplement). Cleaning criteria removed 99/1,927 HC scans; post-clean LOOCV flagged 27/1,828.
